steps.what: List open needs and conflict rows
Confer with management or development teams
Prioritize needs and choose a solution
Sign the priority note
File the signed priority note
outputs: filed copy of signed priority note v1

tasks.design: A job lists open needs and conflicts in {PROJECT}. The developer confers with management or development teams, prioritizes the needs, and chooses the solution. A later job files the signed note in {DOCS}. The meeting stays with the people.
tasks.previous_blocker: Open needs were recopied before each meeting.
tasks.enabler_now: Need identifier and conflict flag are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The conflict is still resolved in the meeting.
tasks.human_edge: The developer and the teams choose the solution.
tasks.altitude: The developer spends the week in the meeting, not on assembling the list.

evidence.claim: The executive digest says a pipeline tests and scans every change, work stays on a branch, and a person merges.

assumptions: Need identifier, conflict flag, and content criterion are stored on the project record. The project record produces them. A blank flag stays blank and is shown as a gap.
Native configuration of the project record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the developer signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining meeting time is still the developer conferring with the teams.

incremental.description: Refresh need identifier and conflict flag when the project layout changes, and drop a note the developer has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many conflict flags are blank. The high end assumes need identifier and conflict flag are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Assemble stored testing result rows
Document testing procedures in the outline
Draft the test plan from those rows

loop.purpose: Draft the test plan so each sentence cites a stored result row.
loop.input: Stored result rows and the outline note.
loop.output: A plan draft whose claims restate those rows.
loop.check: Every number matches a stored row, and every claim is a restatement of that row.
loop.stop: Stop when a number or a claim has no row.
loop.why_not_simpler: A fixed plan template cannot tell which stored result identifier the sentence cites.

steps.what: Check each claim restates a results row
Sign the test plan
File the signed test plan
outputs: filed copy of signed test plan v1

tasks.design: A job assembles stored testing results in {DOCS}. The developer outlines the procedures. A bounded draft writes the plan only from those rows. The developer checks that each claim restates a row. A later job files the signed plan in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Test results were pasted into a fresh plan each time.
tasks.enabler_now: Result identifier and outcome are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: A claim with no row is still the developer's to reject.
tasks.human_edge: The developer decides whether the claim matches the row.
tasks.altitude: The developer spends the week checking claims, not on assembling results.

evidence.claim: The executive digest says a pipeline tests and scans every change, work stays on a branch, and a person merges.
Digest [S27] says models wrote vulnerable code in 45 percent of tests. Generated code is not treated as safe.

assumptions: Result identifier, procedure, and outcome are stored on the test record. The test record produces them. A blank outcome stays blank and cannot be cited.
Native configuration of the test record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the developer signed is filed or sent.
The draft stops when a claim has no row. It does not invent a result.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining check time is still the developer checking each claim.

incremental.description: Refresh result identifier and outcome when the document layout changes, and drop a plan the developer has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many result outcomes are blank. The high end assumes result identifier and outcome are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The web developer spends the week writing, reviewing, and merging. A stored failing check, a blank field, and filing a signed note can move. The developer still reviews every change, and no job changes a live system alone.
reach: A reviewer reads the change before the developer merges it.
A specialist receives only the notice the developer signed.
skills_to_grow: Reject a list that is missing a stored field.
Reject a sentence that does not restate a stored row.
Reject a live change that is not the signed set.
role.ambitious_version: A signed change can be filed the same week, and the developer still owns the merge.
